adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the DB is updated first via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})` and only afterwards the external side effect `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` is executed. There is no surrounding transaction/rollback/compensation if the calendar-provider update fails. Because `uniqueGuests` is computed by filtering out emails already present in `booking.attendees`, a subsequent retry after a failure would likely produce `uniqueGuests.length === 0` and throw `BAD_REQUEST` (`"emails_must_be_unique_valid"`), leaving the external calendar and DB diverged.
